arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-21' AND date < '2019-10-28'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the Monday-to-Sunday week before the week containing the last day of the data.
assumptions: Relative date 'last week' resolved against the last day of the data, 2019-10-31 (a Thursday). The current week is Mon 2019-10-28 to Sun 2019-11-03, so last week is Monday 2019-10-21 to Sunday 2019-10-27.
Counts all transactions regardless of label status, since the question asks about transactions made, not fraud.
Includes transactions with negative amounts, as they are still transaction rows.
